3490-4659-6996-8333.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4659-6996-8333.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sickbay triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

4419-6495--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat
4419-6495--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4094-5478-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
4094-5478-6441-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1308-4826-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3532-5078-6608-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-5662-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Reyhan.
When Reyhan dies, its persist ability and innate ability trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reyhan from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the innate trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on a creature.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1169-1368-5477-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1169-1368-5477-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1636-6797-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Belonging trigger, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
When the Shapeshifters enter, Intruder Alarm triggers three times. Resolve the Intruder Alarm triggers from this step and step 2, untapping all creatures four times.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Belonging.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1558-2557-2638-4231-5621.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2557-2638-4231-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Parallel Lives.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2308-4871-5231-6719.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4871-5231-6719.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Dazzling Angel triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {R}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Dazzling Angel trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

104-4365-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-4365-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

1284-1438.easyPrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Eater of the Dead.
Eater of the Dead does not have summoning sickness.
1284-1438.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Eater of the Dead deathtouch.
1284-1438.description:
Give Eater of the Dead deathtouch by any method.
Activate Eater of the Dead by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any nontoken creature an opponent controls.
The creature dies due to Eater of the Dead's deathtouch.
Activate Eater of the Dead by paying {0}, exiling the creature card from its owner's graveyard  and untapping Eater of the Dead.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

4905-5220-6094-6900.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

225-539-872-5233.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scaled Herbalist as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

1545-2577-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1545-2577-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

843-2645-3392-5313.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 25, reduced by 3 for each {1} available.
843-2645-3392-5313.description:
If you have a life total of 4 or higher, activate Treasonous Ogre by paying 3 life, adding {R}.
Repeat step 1 until you have 3 or fewer life or until you have {8} available.
Activate Lin Sivvi's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for Children of Korlis and putting it onto the battlefield.
Activate Children of Korlis by sacrificing it, causing you to gain life equal to the life you've lost this turn.
Repeat steps 1 and 2 once.
Activate Lin Sivvi's second ability by paying {3}, putting Children of Korlis from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Lin Sivvi.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.

1168-1418-1651-4935-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1418-1651-4935-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1418-1651-4935-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1690-2364-2538-4030.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact permanent in hand that can be cast for at most {1} due to Starnheim Courser.
1690-2364-2538-4030.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying at most {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Vault to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost reduced by {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-2364-2538-4030.notes: You can use an artifact creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

4702-4730.easyPrerequisites: Splinter Twin attached to Sparring Mummy.
4702-4730.description:
Activate Sparring Mummy by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the token Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the nontoken Sparring Mummy.
Repeat.

654-2167-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites: You can produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B} between sacrificing lands excluding Port of Karfell to Squandered Resources and/or by tapping those lands for mana.
654-2167-5531-5732.description:
If desired, activate any number of other mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1} for each land tapped this way.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a mana-producing land other than Port of Karfell, adding {U} or {B} if possible, or any other type of mana otherwise.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other mana-producing lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

2034-2440-3705-4720.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Goblins.
2034-2440-3705-4720.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Squee enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Goblin you control.
Activate Stonework Packbeast twice by paying {4}, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
If you control four or more Goblins, this combo nets infinite mana.

1068-2104-2660.manaNeeded: {8}{U}{U} the first turn, with {3}{U}{U} available each extra turn
1068-2104-2660.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
When Leveler enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling your library.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one, and put Temporal Manipulation on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation from your library.
Repeat from step 3.

381-2452-5243-5256.notablePrerequisites: The Reality Chip attached to any other creature you control.
381-2452-5243-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gravebane Zombie.
Gravebone Zombie is put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target opponent to mill cards equal to Gravebane Zombie's power.
Cast Gravebane Zombie from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Triton Cavalry

716-3388-4445-4618.notablePrerequisites:
Moritte of the Frost does not have summoning sickness.
Leyline Immersion attached to Moritte of the Frost.
716-3388-4445-4618.description:
Activate Moritte by tapping it, adding {3}{G}{G} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Cast Instill Energy by paying {G}, targeting Moritte.
Moritte triggers, returning Leyline Immersion to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Instill Energy by paying {0}, untapping Moritte.
Cast Leyline Immersion by paying {3}{G}, targeting Moritte.
Moritte triggers, returning Instill Energy to your hand from the battlefield.
 Repeat.

2060-3008-3048-4186.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2060-3008-3048-4186.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Roalesk.
Put the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The creature triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak and Crystalline Crawler.
Scurry Oak triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}.
Repeat.

224-1373-3177-3470-4482.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
Sakura-Tribe Scout does not have summoning sickness.
224-1373-3177-3470-4482.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Lotus Cobra and Retreat to Coralhelm twice.
Resolve both Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the first Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, causing you to either tap or untap a creature, or scry 1.
Resolve the second Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Activate Mina and Denn by paying {R}{G} and returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

1061-1953-4615.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{U}{U} on your first turn, with {2}{U}{U} available on each extra turn
1061-1953-4615.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
1061-1953-4615.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Timestream Navigator token.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it and putting it onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat from step 2.
